title: Medical Executive Assistant & Care Coordinator
description:
We are seeking an exceptionally sharp, proactive, and clinically knowledgeable Virtual Medical Executive Assistant & Care Coordinator to support a prestigious, multi-state concierge medical practice headquartered in Alabama. Serving high-net-worth individuals, executives, and CEOs across 10+ states, our practice delivers high-touch concierge and telehealth care where white-glove service, speed, and precision are mandatory.
In this high-level role, you will act as the operational backbone for the practice-managing patient care coordination, triaging high-priority inbox communications via Spruce and Gmail, executing Athena EHR administrative workflows, and assisting with clinical follow-ups. We are seeking an experienced professional who brings proactive ideas to the table, identifies operational inefficiencies, and helps build out standardized operating procedures (SOPs) as our tech-driven practice scales.
Working Environment & Core Schedule

•
Role Title: Virtual Medical Executive Assistant & Care Coordinator

•
Practice Type: High-End Concierge & Telehealth Practice (Serving HNW Clients & CEOs across ~10-11 States)

•
Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week; open to flexible staffing arrangements, minimum 20 hours/week)

•
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST (Central Standard Time)

•
Core Technology Stack (10-15 Platforms): Athena EHR (Source of Truth), Spruce (Patient Communication), Google Workspace/Gmail, Claude AI & specialized medical AI tools.

Top 3 Daily Tasks

•
Clinical Care Coordination & Patient Follow-Ups: Execute high-touch patient follow-ups, coordinate telehealth/concierge care plans, and manage weekly prior authorization submissions in Athena.

•
Executive Inbox & Communication Management: Monitor, prioritize, and triage rapid patient communications and administrative inquiries across Spruce and Gmail with impeccable tone and discretion.

•
Process Optimization & SOP Building: Identify operational bottlenecks across our multi-platform tech stack, propose workflow enhancements, and draft clear SOPs to streamline practice efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

•
Athena EHR Management: Maintain pristine patient records, update charts, track lab/diagnostic orders, and manage administrative workflows within Athena EHR.

•
Prior Authorization Handling: Compile clinical notes, submit prior authorization requests (~1 per week), and track approval statuses with commercial insurance payors.

•
Patient & Client Engagement: Deliver white-glove, highly professional communications to executive-level patients via Spruce and email, ensuring rapid turnaround times and utmost privacy.

•
Tech Stack Integration & AI Utilization: Comfortably navigate and leverage a 10-15 platform technology stack, incorporating Claude AI and specialized medical software into daily administrative workflows.

•
Proactive Practice Operations: Continuously evaluate daily administrative tasks, bring optimization ideas to practice leadership, and build out standardized procedural documentation.

Requirements

•
Athena EHR Experience: Direct, hands-on administrative or clinical experience navigating Athena EHR (non-negotiable priority).

•
Clinical Knowledge & Experience: Deep baseline understanding of clinical terminology, medical workflows, and patient care management.

•
Tech Literacy & Adaptability: Exceptional comfort with modern software, AI tools (e.g., Claude), multi-channel phone/text platforms (Spruce), and multi-system tech stacks.

•
Executive Client Management: Proven ability to communicate effectively, professionally, and confidentially with high-expectation, high-net-worth clientele.

•
Proactive Problem Solving: Demonstrated track record of working independently, taking ownership of tasks, and proposing workflow improvements rather than waiting for instruction.

•
English Fluency: Flawless, highly articulate spoken and written English skills (all patients are English-speaking).

•
Remote Workspace: Dedicated, quiet, HIPAA-complian

- A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

description:

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role  

We are looking for a Principal Customer Success Portfolio Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role  reporting to the Sr Director, Customer Success Strategy & Operations in the Customer Success department. In this role, you will lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of the Customer Success Portfolio across the Professional Services, Technical Success, and Support departments to deliver high-impact experiences and foster continuous growth.

• Develop well-structured and measurable service offerings aligned with the customer lifecycle and company vision

• Audit and evaluate existing portfolio items for relevance, accuracy, and customer satisfaction impact

• Collaborate with cross-department stakeholders to align portfolio goals and streamline processes

• Create metrics, KPIs, and governance processes to assess portfolio effectiveness and improve adoption rates

• Stay updated on industry trends and recommend improvements that enhance the portfolio's strategic value

• You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You build deep empathy for the customer and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems.

• You operate with integrity and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between strategy and hands-on execution.

• You use data and analytics to measure what matters and guide informed decisions.

• You connect your work to the larger company mission and build scalable solutions designed for a global organization.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field

• 8+ years of experience in portfolio management, program management, or customer success roles

• Expertise in auditing and optimizing service documentation to meet business standards

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

• Proven ability to analyze data and create actionable performance metrics

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with SaaS, B2B technology solutions, or similar industries

• Demonstrated success in leading cross-departmental initiatives to scale service portfolios

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business-whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why would you love this job?

The Regional Sales Director will have leadership responsibility for the sales activities and operations across the West. Ideally this person will be located in the Western Region.

The objective of this role is to lead a growing team of sales pros in the region who are focused on expanding our growing customer base and generating more business from current customers. For this critical position we are seeking a thoughtful, disciplined and passionate leader who will bring significant experience and credibility to the West Coast team.

The Ideal candidate will have experience leading a quarterly-focused technology company through a period of successful and rapid growth. Have personal success in sales and sales management, with a consistent history of high performance. A naturally strategic focus with the ability to also lead by example; will not hesitate to get into the details of the business to help their team execute. The skills and personality to prioritize and juggle multiple tasks simultaneously

What you’ll do:

- Drive both strategic account planning and flawless tactical execution

- Manage accurate monthly and quarterly forecasting across the region

- Nurture broad, high-value key client executive relationships to ensure customer retention and loyalty

- Oversee the planning and implementation of regional marketing/sales programs

- Maintain appropriate reporting systems to participate in meetings and business reviews

- Recruit, train and manage a world-class sales organization

- Grow and accelerate the sales funnel across the region

- At least three years of proven sales team management and four years of direct sales experience

- Database sales experience

Data & Analysis

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring a Manager, Learning & Certification Architecture to define how customers learn Harvey and to build the system that produces that learning at scale. You’ll own the learning and certification strategy across Harvey Academy, the Help Center and in-product education: who we teach, what each persona needs to be able to do, and which format fits each learning problem. Harvey ships new product every week, so you’ll also design the agentic workflows that draft content from product sources, set the quality bar and review steps every piece passes before it publishes. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll build content yourself while guiding a team of learning experience designers and a certification developer.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build a leveled, persona-based curriculum for associates, partners, knowledge managers, in-house counsel and administrators, with clear outcomes and assessments from first use to certified practitioner.

- Design the agentic production workflows, including the instructional standards the agents are built on and the review gates and rubrics content must pass before it publishes.

- Own publishing, maintenance and localization across surfaces, working with Engineering and Localization so each product release reaches every asset it affects.

- Guide the designers and certification developer, and work with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Support and Legal Engineering on release readiness and learning success metrics.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 5+ years in learning experience design, instructional design or learning architecture for a technical product, including 2+ years leadership experience.

- A track record of building a leveled, persona-based curriculum or certification program from scratch, including competency models, assessments and pass standards.

- Hands-on production skill in at least two of: long-form writing, video or audio.

- Fluency with AI tools in your own work, and experience designing workflows where models draft and people review.

- Experience running a CMS (e.g., Sanity) and and an LMS (e.g. Skilljar), and using learning data to set priorities and measure results.

- Experience teaching lawyers or other professionals, or familiarity with CLE accreditation, is a plus.

COMPENSATION

ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team: The AI Simulation (AI Sim) division at SandboxAQ applies physics and AI simulation to problems in drug discovery and the material sciences. You will work within a highly skilled, multidisciplinary team of computational chemists, physicists, AI experts, and software engineers, on a generative platform that is used across both application areas.

Introduction to the role: We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to help build the generative engine at the centre of SandboxAQ's material discovery work. The platform finds compounds that match a desired property profile by navigating chemical space while balancing multiple competing objectives. You will: (1) implement, extend, and optimise frontier generative architectures for material discovery; (2) own the interface between the generative engine and the property predictors that supply its reward signal; (3) identify, ingest, and quality-control the data these models are trained and evaluated on; and (4) turn the models you build into production capability that discovery scientists across the company can run.

See how SandboxAQ is helping build America's semiconductor supply chain from the materials up https://www.sandboxaq.com/post/sandboxaq-helping-build-americas-semiconductor-supply-chain

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Architect and evolve our flagship generative platform, serving as a core contributor to the engine that will redefine how the industry discovers new materials.

- Implement and optimize state-of-the-art generative models - including diffusion, flow-matching, and GFlowNets, or LLM- and agent-based methods - to navigate high-dimensional chemical space and solve the multi-objective optimization problems that material discovery presents.

- Own the reward interface. Integrate learned surrogates, and simulation-derived oracles as the objective signal driving generation, and design reward formulations that hold up when several objectives are in genuine tension e.g. performance against environmental and safety constraints.

- Develop and deploy computational methods and workflows to generate and evaluate hypotheses, guiding design decisions and influencing project direction.

- Identify relevant data sources and take responsibility for data ingestion, QC, and validation.

- Collaborate daily with a core group of ML researchers to implement frontier generative architectures, while working closely with the broader R&D, discovery, engineering, and product teams.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on expertise building and shipping modern generative or applied ML for material discovery with at least 4+ years of experience delivering these solutions in industry or an equivalent research setting.

- Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, and robust production-grade code designed for industry-scale applications.

- Proven ability to build scalable ML, e.g. using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

- Familiarity with cloud-base

title: 2028 Strategist Fellowship
description:
Note: We are currently collecting resumes for this role; hiring will happen on a rolling basis and begin in earnest in November and December. Details of role may be revised when hiring begins.
Blue Rose Research helps Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We work with campaigns in battleground races up and down the ballot and major Democratic, progressive, and advocacy organizations across the country to produce the research and build the tools they use to decide what to say and where to spend.
We produce opinion research at a scale unmatched in politics, put it directly in decision-makers’ hands, and build tools on top of that data that we distribute widely across the progressive ecosystem. You’ll be joining a team of decorated engineers, data scientists, and political analysts who have quietly helped shape how the progressive ecosystem communicates for years.
Blue Rose provides tools and data to all Democratic campaigns; many campaigns are looking for a thought partner who knows how to leverage them. As the 2028 presidential election approaches, we're building out a bench of strategists to support our work with the many campaigns and organizations shaping the primaries and the general that follows. We're looking for a range of skills and backgrounds, but generally want people who are highly proactive, execution-driven, fluent in campaigns and elections, excited to learn, and effective with all levels of campaign stakeholders from junior field organizers to political directors.
This posting is closer to a resume drop than a single job description, and we expect the function, structure, and duration of the role to shift based on the candidate. The role could be full time through the duration of the 2028 cycle, a short-term fellowship, part time, or on a project-basis. We're not looking to keep anyone from ultimately joining a campaign if that's where the work leads, and we expect needs will vary.
In this role, you will:

• Apply Blue Rose's data and tools to turn findings into guidance a non-technical audience can act on

• Determine what a campaign needs, and build credibility quickly with candidates, clients, and senior staff

• Take on ambiguous, open-ended work without waiting to be told what's needed

• Operate in a fast-moving environment where plans change often and answers are needed quickly

• Provide feedback on Blue Rose’s tools and help refine our offerings for 2028

Example backgrounds that could be a fit:

• A comms staffer who has run message discipline or rapid response through a competitive statewide or federal race

• A paid media or digital lead who has managed a significant budget for a campaign, party committee, or PAC, and can incorporate testing results into a media plan

• A campaign operative with relationships across the Democratic consultant, vendor, and staffer ecosystem

• A researcher or analyst who has turned data into recommendations that a principal or client acted on

Qualified candidates ideally have:

• Multiple election cycles of experience in Democratic politics across campaigns, party committees, or political consultancies

• Excellent written and verbal communication, and experience delivering presentations to principals and senior staff that shape what a campaign decides to do

• Strong political instincts and bias towards action to go above and beyond a campaign’s needs

• Comfort picking up new tools and new data quickly, without needing a technical background

• Kindness, humility, and a collaborative spirit

The example backgrounds are non-exhaustive, and we don't expect every applicant to have expertise in every area listed above. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't sound like a perfect fit.
Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.
Salary range: Because the format of this role is flexible, compensation will be set based on role, duration, and experience. Expected range for part-time/contract roles is $5,000 - $20,0

This is a hands-on role. You will lead technical discovery, facilitate workshops, analyze industrial environments, build architecture and roadmap deliverables, guide delivery teams, and present recommendations to client leaders. title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
description: What we’re building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. title: Solution Architect-North Central
description:
THE ROLE

As an Enterprise Solutions Architect at ClickHouse, you'll own the technical side of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the North Central United States. This role serves our Enterprise segment across the North Central region, and the ideal candidate would be based in Minneapolis or Chicago.

You'll engage with data platform engineers, architects, SRE, and the VP who owns the standard - and your job is to design something that satisfies all of them and then prove it at production scale. Getting an enterprise team there usually means moving them off something else, so most of your work is making that migration credible: the architecture, benchmarks run against their own data, and a plan their engineers believe they can execute.

This is a role for engineers who want the hard version of the problem: real scale, real constraints, and an incumbent to displace. Prior pre-sales experience helps but isn't required - technical depth is non-negotiable.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Own the technical evaluation for enterprise accounts - from discovery through POC or competitive bake-off, architecture sign-off, security review, and first production workload.

- Engage across a wider set of stakeholders than a single team: data platform engineers, architects, SRE, security, and the executive who owns the standard. Design solutions that hold up with all of them in the room.

- Design for production scale - sizing, sharding and replication strategy, ingestion topology, tiered storage, cost modeling, and what happens when something fails at 3am.

- Win competitive displacements against Elasticsearch, Splunk, Snowflake, BigQuery, Druid, Pinot, and homegrown systems, using benchmarks the customer's own team can reproduce.

- Own the migration plan - sequencing, dual-run, validation, and cutover - so the customer's team can see exactly how they get to production.

- Clear the security and procurement path: questionnaires, compliance artifacts, network and identity architecture, and BYOC or private deployment requirements.

- Partner closely with Enterprise AEs to progress and close opportunities - you own the technical win, they own the commercial close. Build the TCO case against the incumbent/competition together.

- Advocate for customer needs internally with Product and Engineering - you're the voice of the technical buyer inside ClickHouse.

- Contribute reference architectures, benchmark harnesses, migration guides, and objection handling material that help the team scale what's working.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Deep technical foundation in data infrastructure - built through experience as a data engineer, platform engineer, software engineer, DBA, or solutions architect.

- Production experience with analytical databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, Pinot, Vertica) and with operating them, not just querying them.

- Distributed systems judgment: partitioning, replication, consistency trade-offs, query execution, and a felt sense for where things break under load.

- Fluency across the modern data stack - Kafka and CDC pipelines, orchestration, object storage, BI tools, and at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) at architecture level.

- Experience running a technical evaluation against a named competitor and winning it, including designing the migration off the incumbent and the parts of it that are genuinely hard.

- Customer-facing experience with real stakes - pre-sales, consulting, technical account management, or a staff-level engineering role that put you in front of customers.

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can whiteboard with a staff engineer in the morning and present to a VP of Engineering in the afternoon.

- Comfort with longer cycles and more stakeholders. Enterprise evaluations don't close in three weeks, and you know how to keep one moving without letting it stall.

- Willingness to say ClickHouse isn't the right tool for a given workload when that's true.

PERKS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.

• Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

What You WON'T Do

Culture fit

title: Staff Product Designer, Credit Builder
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

STAFF PRODUCT DESIGNER (IC7), CREDIT BUILDER

Location: Miami (hybrid). We'll also consider candidates near other Nubank hubs, including São Paulo.

Team: Global Credit Card, Credit Builder

ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people across Latin America have never had a credit card. For many of them, Nubank is the first institution that gives them a real path to one. Credit Builder is where that path starts.

Our Credit Builder card is an entry-level credit product. Customers add money to unlock spending power, and we coach them step by step toward a full credit limit. The goal isn't to keep people on a starter product. It's to move them up and out of it, and most of our success stories do exactly that. The experience is built around gamification. A guided timeline walks customers through adding to their money box, increasing their limit, setting up autopay and building healthy habits. It has become one of the highest-NPS experiences at Nu and a model for gamification across the company.

Today Credit Builder runs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. Next year our scope roughly flips. We'll bring our under-18 credit product, our credit score product (NuScore) and Credit Builder into more countries, possibly including the US. We're also planning a significant revamp of the core experience.

We're hiring a Staff Product Designer to help set the craft bar for this work. You'll be one of the most senior designers in Global Credit Card, working on both the high-visibility revamp and the day-to-day product work that keeps a fast-moving, multi-country team shipping.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead design for Credit Builder and related underserved-credit products across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia and new markets, including the US.

- Drive the upcoming revamp of the Credit Builder experience, raising the bar on visual craft, interaction design and motion.

- Design global solutions that hold together as one system while adapting to local needs, such as regulatory requirements, cultural context and market-specific constraints.

- Push gamification and financial-coaching patterns further, helping customers understand how credit works and how to grow it.

- Mentor and level up the more junior designers on the team, through critiques and day-to-day collaboration.

- Partner closely with product managers, engineers, business analysts and a dedicated researcher, plus the market design teams in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia and adjacent teams such as Growth, Core and Collections.

- Get hands-on with the full range of work, from the most ambitious projects to quick everyday design tasks, and move fast across both.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- An exceptional craft bar: polished visual and interaction design, strong systems thinking, and comfort with motion.

- Proven experience designing complex products, ideally in fintech, financial services or other regulated or multi-market settings.

- Strong strategic judgment, and comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities and shifting scope.

- Excellent stakeholder management across countries, time zones and functions, with the ability to align global and local partners.

- A low-ego, hands-on mindset. On a lean team covering many products and markets, everyone pitches in, including senior folks.

- Experience mentoring designers and raising the quality of a team's work.

- A portfolio that shows both depth of craft and the thinking behind it.

NICE TO HAVE

- Spanish and/or Portuguese.

- Experience

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

As a Senior Data Scientist within our Autoplanner team, you will build AI-powered systems that unify planning across global warehouses and last-mile operations. You will be responsible for developing the machine learning models, optimisation algorithms, and operational simulations that underpin our core planning products. By taking high-impact models from concept through to monitored production systems, you will ensure automated operational plans are robust, globally optimised, and trusted to run live across our partners' international supply chains.

Working closely with cross-functional software engineers and product managers, you will set the technical direction for key initiatives while mentoring colleagues to elevate the team’s overall data science capabilities. You will also engage directly with internal and external stakeholders, including global retail partners - to translate complex logistics challenges into production-ready data science solutions, shaping the future of autonomous operational planning.

• Develop the technical capabilities of data scientists across the team through mentoring, technical guidance, and collaboration.

• Partner with software engineers to ensure models are cleanly packaged, deployed, monitored, and efficiently served on the platform.

• Own relationships with product managers, internal partner teams, and external retailers to align on requirements and delivery roadmaps.

• Proven track record of taking data science and machine learning models into production, maintaining them, and leading initiatives end-to-end.

• Strong machine learning and statistical expertise, including the ability to evaluate model performance rigorously against business metrics.

title: Inside Sales Executive (Member Success)
description:
INSIDE SALES EXECUTIVE (MEMBER SUCCESS)

£60,000-£70,000 OTE (£40,000 base salary + uncapped commission) and a comprehensive benefits package

Location: London office | Office-based, 5 days a week

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy connecting with people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

Help the Members who already trust Teya get more from us, and build your earnings by doing it.

As an Inside Sales Executive in our Member Success team, you’ll work only with Members who already use Teya, never new leads. Make no mistake: this is a sales role, not an account management one. You’ll study how each Member’s business is trading, spot where our wider products could help it grow, and sell the right solution through consultative conversations.

Success is measured by how much more each Member gets from Teya and how much more each relationship is worth over time, not by one-off sales. Expect clear activity and revenue targets, uncapped commission and real progression for people who perform.

Our Member Success team is set to triple in size, so there’s real room to grow with it.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Read the account first: Review each Member’s trading patterns, seasonality and product usage to find genuine cross-sell and upsell opportunities before you pick up the phone.

- Understand the business: Talk with owners about their goals, cash flow and pressures, and work out what would genuinely make a difference.

- Sell the wider suite: Recommend and sell products including Merchant Cash Advance (MCA), the Teya business account, credit cards and loans.

- Sell responsibly: Be clear about how each product works, what it costs and when it isn’t the right fit, so every Member knows exactly what they’re agreeing to.

- Close and hand over: Work through objections and own each opportunity from first conversation to agreement and handover.

- Run your portfolio: Manage your book of Members with strong CRM discipline, so no opportunity in your portfolio goes untouched.

- Grow lifetime value: Make sure every product you sell earns its place, so Members stay with Teya longer and do more with us.

- Work as one team: Partner with Inside Sales, Onboarding, Risk and Customer Support, and feed back what Members tell you to shape how we sell, support and build our products.

Your Story

The best people in this role are salespeople who think like advisers. Your Members already know Teya, so the job isn’t winning their attention. It’s earning the right to recommend more, and getting that recommendation right.

It’s a great fit if you’d rather go deep with a portfolio of businesses than chase a stream of new leads.

We’re looking for people who bring:

- Sales experience: A track record in a target-driven sales role, ideally including cross-selling or upselling to an existing customer base. Phone-based experience helps, but it isn’t essential.

- Commercial curiosity: You can read an account, spot a pattern in the numbers and turn it into a reason to call.
